hero.subtitle: Since 1994, Vijay Jewellery Collection has embodied uncompromising goldsmithing mastery—creating certified solitaires, antique polki chokers, and bespoke bridal treasures that endure across generations.

craftsmanship.title: The Soul of Bengali Goldsmithing
craftsmanship.quote: True luxury is not manufactured; it is sculpted with reverence. For thirty years, our atelier karigars have preserved ancestral goldsmithing secrets—uniting unyielding diamond brilliance with timeless hallmarked gold.

footer.aboutText: Custodians of royal Indian jewelry art since 1994. Every gemstone is ethically sourced, rigorously authenticated, and set by master goldsmiths in our Kolkata atelier.
